findings.finding: Initial append-only manifest identity included volatile live tail length/hash; removed volatile live-tail observations from canonical epoch identity while keeping them as diagnostics. Frozen criteria unchanged.

A capsule evaluator rewrote declared Tier-1 evidence after compile/minimize; the active transaction digest remained unchanged, finalize classified it as expected output, and queued it for the next epoch.
The subsequent epoch captured the newly generated Tier-1 artifact.
A live-revalidate-only authority without a deterministic verifier was refused instead of frozen.
Corrected Experiment Capsule child-exit and Gen9 metric field names; no thresholds or gold changed.
Changed the control artifact to derive from starting SHA256 so every benchmark rerun deterministically causes a real mutation.
Polling appended audit telemetry during a historical exact-digest window; semantic metrics stayed green and quiescent Gen9 rerun passed 20/20.
After the final Twin rebuild, two independent epoch starts and transactions were deterministic, non-fail-closed, and finalized with no unsafe or pending changes.

starting_problem.finding: Gen9 correctly failed closed after its evaluator rewrote Tier-1 evidence newer than the Twin; the safety rule was correct, but compile/minimize/evaluate lacked a coherent transaction boundary.
